title: Friend Bank: Build Our Democratic Base in Racine!
description:
### Join us to talk to our neighbors and fight back against the Republican agenda!

In Racine, we have a huge opportunity to flip State Senate District 21—one of the **most competitive** districts in the entire state! Under current Republican leadership, the state legislature has rejected expanding Medicaid, slashed public education funding, and restricted access to reproductive health care. But we can change that. 

If we start connecting with voters about the issues that matter to them and building our volunteer team this summer, we’ll have the power we need to flip this district next year. We can decide control of the Wisconsin State Senate and elect Democrats who will protect our health care, invest in public education, and stand up for reproductive freedom.

During this event, you'll learn how to use the REACH app to contact people in our community about voting and taking action, and then we'll reach out to our networks together. **Sign up here to build power in Racine County and fight for a better future for all Wisconsinites!**

Join the Paulding County Democrats for the monthly meeting of our Banned Book Club. We'll have an evening of discussion and celebration of banned books. Let's explore the stories challenged and understand the importance of freedom of expression.

Our book will be "The Perks of Being a Wallflower," a 1999 young adult novel by American author Stephen Chbosky. *If you have only one hour per week to give, be sure to choose the most effective action you can.*

title: NO KINGS Seal Beach PCH Rally
description:
In California, we don’t put up with would-be kings.

On June 14, we’ll gather and span the length of the Pacific Coast Highway—To say the Orange County Coast has no king!

While Donald Trump throws himself a made-for-TV military parade in Washington, communities across the country are rising up to remind the world where real power lives: not in spectacle, but in solidarity.
From Seal Beach to Laguna Niguel, Orange County residents will line the Pacific Coast Highway in coordinated protest, culminating at Main Beach in Laguna for a unifying demonstration to defend democracy and reject authoritarianism.

This event is part of NO KINGS, a nationwide day of action sparked by a growing movement to stand up to the corruption, extremism, and authoritarian politics of Trump and his allies. We’ve watched them crack down on free speech, defy the courts, target immigrant communities, and strip away rights—while serving the interests of billionaires.
We’re not gathering to feed his ego. We’re building a movement that leaves him behind.
This is more than a protest—it’s a stand for our future, our freedoms, and our community.

The flag doesn’t belong to Trump. It belongs to us.
 This country doesn’t belong to a king—it belongs to the people.
Let’s show what democracy looks like: united, visible, and grounded in collective purpose.

Bring your signs, sunscreen, water—and your voice.
 This is a peaceful, family-friendly event. All are welcome.

title: Weekly (Fri) Mass Pike Overpass Standout in Westfield - Southampton Rd (Routes 10/202)
description:
Wow! What a great location for a standout! On 5/30, around 17 people, including a bagpiper!  What a blast! LOTS of engagement with motorists!

There's lots and lots of traffic passing by. Southampton Road (Routes 10/202) is heavily traveled northbound and southbound, and the Mass Pike eastbound and westbound is below. Lots of honks and thumbs up and waves...and a few folks flying middle fingers. We smile and wave at them all! 

We'll have letterboards prepared for the lower part of the overpass fencing - the photo shows how that will look to folks passing on the Mass Pike. We're interacting with motorists on the Mass Pike, and on Southampton Road. We've discovered that the magic happens when we smile and wave to people!

Come when you can, and leave when you must. You needn't be present for the entire 1 1/2 hours.

### How to Get There

The address "130 Southampton Road, Westfield" will get you just north of the overpass. 

### Parking

We can't park in the Southampton Rd breakdown lane. There are vacant business properties north of the bridge, and it seems that parking would be OK there.

It looks like The Wealth Technology Group has vacated their office at 130 Southampton Rd, but the internet says that other businesses are located there, so please be mindful if you decide to park there.

### Etiquette!

We don't give the finger to people who give the finger to us, or who say unpleasant things. We smile and wave to them, too. 

We may see a counter protester. If so, the best thing to do is just ignore them and spend our time and energy waving to motorists. Let's keep things 100% non-confrontational in words and body language.

### Other Stuff

Please take everything you brought away with you, and leave the site totally clean.

If rain is predicted, we'll cancel. If we cancel, you'll receive an email notification.

### A Few Requests

We've found that roof rake sections make wonderful flagpoles and banner poles. If you have a roof rake (or 10’-15’ light metal poles or conduit) to contribute, we'll be happy to take it off your hands!

And, if you have an extra 3' x 5' American flag you're not using, we'd love it if you'd pass it on to us!

title: March to the Park!
description:
This a local Indivisible event!

Mark your calendars! Bring the kids! Join us on June 21st @ 10:30am for our March to the Park! from the Tuscarawas Co Courthouse to Tuscora Park (one mile). Join us afterwards for a potluck. Together with the League of Women Voters Tuscarawas County, we are collecting monetary donations for Jack’s House of Hope. 

Departure time: 10:45am! Bring your own signs to this event.

Signs

For this event, please bring your own signs. They can be on wood sticks such as tomatoe posts for ease of carrying. Make your message clear: Federal, state, and local issues of concern to you, your family, the community…there are just so many issues my head would explode if I wrote them all down. Pre-made signs will not be available for this event.

Monetary Donations

Together with the League of Women Voters of Tusc County, we are asking marchers to make a monetary donation of any amount for Jack’s House of Hope. Monetary donations for Jack’s House of Hope will be collected at Tuscora Park. Amanda Fontana, Friends of the Homeless of Tuscarawas County Board of Directors' Secretary will speak about the importance of our local shelter.

March, Eat, Chat, Play!

Our event is from 10:30am-12:30pm. We will march to Tuscora Park from the Tuscarawas County Courthouse and then share a covered dish and/or just bring something for yourself/your family, your own paper products/utensils, snacks to share, and good conversation with those joining us. If you bring something to share, please be mindful of allergies. An index card with a list of ingredients taped to the container would be appreciated. Label containers with your name if you want them back! Jenn Schrock will oversee the food/refreshments while we march.

Half of a covered pavilion near the bocce courts has been reserved for this event. Blankets and chairs can be dropped off beforehand. Marchers can carpool back to the Tusc Co Courthouse to then walk to the park (10:45am). For those that do not have a way back to the courthouse to march, Alicia Hall will help transport people to the courthouse BEFORE the march once they drop off their items at the park.

Remember: Bring your own signs to this event!

Kids can play on the playground equipment. Park rides and Putt-Putt golf open at NOON. See pricing at www.tuscorapark.com/park-info-contact.

We’ll take a group picture!

Helpers

We will also be inviting everyone to join us on Sunday afternoon on June 29th for a premiere of a show we're featured on!

We think making calls makes a difference. We don't ask for money. We don't solicit. We're about strengthening our bonds as neighbors!

description:

They’ve done this all while continuing to serve and enrich their billionaire allies.

The flag doesn’t belong to Donald Trump. It belongs to us. We’re not watching history happen. We’re making it.

On June 14th, we’re showing up everywhere he isn’t—to say no thrones, no crowns, no kings. Check out nokings.org for more information.

Join us on the pedestrian bridge over Montlake Blvd between the Burke Gilman Trail and the UW Montlake Parking Lot (E01).

- attacks on due process and immigrants
- abdication of checks and balances by Congress and the Courts
- theft of our data by Musk and DOGE
- corruption by the President

Bring your own sign or borrow one of ours, we always have extras!

See you Tuesday! 

— Robin

Tesla Takedown is a peaceful protest movement. We oppose violence, vandalism and destruction of property. Please treat Tesla drivers with respect as they are most likely on our side!
